verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows attaching a screenshot, image, or marked-up mockup to a task or prompt. The closest features are adjacent, not the capability itself: the browser-pane Design tool sends a selected element's context to an agent, and team comments on agent-created designs can be turned into updates. The axis applies to an agent-orchestration tool, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change
